entries.proposition: The WWOX intronic SNP did not reach the study’s own genome-wide threshold for white matter volume.
entries.snippet: An intronic SNP in WWOX (rs10514437) fell just short of genome-wide significance for WM

entries.proposition: The study threshold is a Bonferroni division of the conventional threshold by four phenotypes.
entries.snippet: were considered genome-wide significant (Bonferroni correction for four MRI phenotypes

entries.proposition: rs10514437 is directly genotyped, not imputed.
entries.snippet: Note that all SNPs are imputed with the exception of rs10514437

entries.proposition: A1 in Table 1 is the effect allele; the per-allele difference is effect size over mean volume.
entries.snippet: A1 is the effective allele and A2 is the reference allele. Diff./allele is the ratio of effect size over mean brain volume.

entries.proposition: The adolescent and adult cohorts are not a replication sample, by the authors’ statement.
entries.snippet: These comparisons do not represent a conventional replication sample.

entries.proposition: The authors call for independent replication.
The link to white matter is an interpretation resting on cited adult WOX1 expression, not on a measurement in this study.
entries.snippet: are high in neuronal axons and nerve bundles such as corpus callosum and striatal fascicles

entries.proposition: Supplementary Table 10 reports no PNC and no ENIGMA2 value for rs10514437 (NA): it was not tested in either comparison cohort.
Supplementary Table 8: the effect allele G has frequency about 0.97 in the current sample; the minor allele is A.

The permutation test gives an empirical p of 8e-8 for rs10514437 with WM (8 exceedances in 10^8 permutations; the derived text drops the superscript and prints 108), which is above the study's 1.25e-8 threshold and about five times the analytic 1.56e-8.
entries.snippet: yielding an empirical p-value of 8 x 10-8 for the rs10514437 association with WM

entries.proposition: Supplementary Figure 4, WM panel for rs10514437, inspected: the index SNP stands alone at -log10 p about 7.8 at about 78.49 Mb (hg19, the plot's axis), inside the WWOX gene track; no other SNP in the window rises above about 3, and the few at about 3 (r2 0.4-0.6) sit near 78.51 Mb. The signal has no LD-supported regional architecture: one genotyped low-frequency SNP. The panel bears on the Results sentence calling it intronic in WWOX and agrees with it.
entries.snippet: [figure attestation - pixels cannot be quote-matched] Supplementary Figure 4 top-left panel: purple diamond labelled rs10514437 near y = 7.8 above x about 78.49 on 'Position on chr16 (Mb)' (78.2-78.8 ticks); WWOX gene arrow spans the track; remaining points dark blue (r2 < 0.2) below about 3, two green points near 3 at about 78.51.

entries.proposition: Supplementary Figure 7 inspected: three called genotype clusters with ellipses; a large BB cluster (B = G, the common allele), an AB cluster of about 49 markers by a connected-component count of the blue fill (overlapping markers can merge, so a lower bound), no AA marker, two no-calls. The WM association rests on heterozygous carriers of the minor allele; no minor homozygote was observed.
entries.snippet: [figure attestation - pixels cannot be quote-matched] Supplementary Figure 7, title snp_rs10514437_0w_f: red triangles (BB) dense at log ratio about -2.7; blue squares (AB) at about -0.4; empty green AA ellipse at about 1.7; two grey NoCall markers between BB and AB.

entries.proposition: Appendix 2 page 4 inspected: in 15 of the 16 WWOX region panels the postnatal points sit above the prenatal ones (titles give uncorrected P from 0 to 0.0086); hippocampus is the exception (P 0.1055). None of the panels is stratified by genotype.
entries.snippet: [figure attestation - pixels cannot be quote-matched] Appendix 2 page 4: sixteen scatter panels titled WWOX with region names; x 'age (days when <0, years when >0)', y 'Normalized expression level'; postnatal clouds higher in all but the hippocampus panel.

entries.proposition: Appendix 3 page 5 inspected: of the eleven WWOX exonic segments plotted for the amygdaloid complex, the two non-canonical ones (78,312,499-78,312,593 and the intron-8 segment 78,790,836-78,790,912) sit at about zero expression in nearly every sample; the canonical exons are expressed.
entries.snippet: [figure attestation - pixels cannot be quote-matched] Appendix 3 page 5: panels WWOX_78312499_78312593 and WWOX_78790836_78790912 show y values at 0 for almost all points (y-axis maxima about 0.9 and 1.8), while e.g. WWOX_79245504_79246031 spans about 2-12.
